proof_body:
by
  intro S M _ _ _ p q
  constructor
  · intro h x
    exact Submodule.existsUnique_add_of_isCompl_prod h x
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
      intro x hp hq
      have e := (h x).unique (y₁ := (⟨x, hp⟩, 0)) (y₂ := (0, ⟨x, hq⟩)) (by simp) (by simp)
      simpa using congrArg (fun u : p × q => (u.1 : M)) e
    · rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
      intro x _
      obtain ⟨u, hu, _⟩ := h x
      exact Submodule.mem_sup.mpr ⟨u.1, u.1.2, u.2, u.2.2, hu⟩
target_source: ∀ (S M : Type*) [Ring S] [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M] (p q : Submodule S M), IsCompl p q ↔ ∀ x : M, ∃! u : p × q, (u.1 : M) + u.2 = x
